ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$ AB=10, BC=6\\
$\therefore$ AC=16\\
Also, $\because$ M is the midpoint of AC, $\therefore$ MC=AM=8\\
$\because$ N is the midpoint of BC, $\therefore$ BN=NC=3\\
BM=AB−AM=10−8=\boxed{2}\\
MN=BM+BN=2+3=\boxed{5}
